records.speaker: Alchemist
records.source: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ An Abiphone? What kind of witchcraft is that?
records.translation: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ Абифон? Что это за колдовство?

records.speaker: Angler Angus
records.source: [NPC] Angler Angus: You can store Bait in your inventory or Fishing Bag, which is unlocked at Raw Cod Collection III.
records.translation: [NPC] Angler Angus: Храни наживку в инвентаре или сумке для рыбалки. Сумка открывается на III уровне коллекции сырой трески.

records.speaker: Baker
records.source: [NPC] Baker: My Wheat Minions produce the finest flour around, but they can't keep up with today's demand...
records.translation: [NPC] Baker: Мои пшеничные миньоны производят лучшую муку в округе, но сегодня они не справляются со спросом...

records.speaker: Bartender
records.source: [NPC] Bartender: These are trying times, indeed. The Graveyard up ahead is overflowing with monsters! Anyone who comes in is spooked off by the grunts of Zombies in the distance.
records.translation: [NPC] Bartender: Нелёгкие настали времена. Кладбище впереди кишит чудовищами! Стоит кому-то зайти — и рычание зомби тут же обращает его в бегство.

records.speaker: Bea
records.source: [NPC] Bea: Personally, I prefer the bee pet!
records.translation: [NPC] Bea: Лично мне больше всего нравится пчела!

records.speaker: Bingo
records.source: [NPC] Bingo: If you join, you have 7 days to complete as many tasks as you can on a fresh, temporary profile!
records.translation: [NPC] Bingo: Присоединяйся! У тебя будет 7 дней, чтобы выполнить побольше заданий на новом временном профиле.

records.speaker: Bingo
records.source: [NPC] Bingo: At the end of the event, your Bingo profile will be deleted.
records.translation: [NPC] Bingo: После события твой профиль Бинго будет удалён.

records.speaker: Bingo
records.source: [NPC] Bingo: You can spend these points in the Bingo Shop on any profile!
records.translation: [NPC] Bingo: Эти очки можно потратить в магазине Бинго с любого профиля!

records.speaker: Bingo
records.source: [NPC] Bingo: You have 7 days to complete as many tasks as you can on a fresh, temporary profile!
records.translation: [NPC] Bingo: У тебя есть 7 дней, чтобы выполнить побольше заданий на новом временном профиле!

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: I'm the town Blacksmith! I can reforge items for you, for a price.
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: Я городской кузнец! Перекую твои предметы — за плату.

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: Reforging usually costs Coins, but since I'm feeling friendly I can reforge your first item for Coal x10.
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: Обычно перековка стоит монет, но сегодня я добрый: первый предмет перекую за уголь x10.

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: Reach Mining Level I to gain access to the Gold Mine, north of the Coal Mine.
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: Достигни I уровня горного дела, чтобы попасть в Золотую шахту к северу от Угольной шахты.

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: However, this time I will reforge any item for the low price of Coal x10!
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: Но сейчас перекую любой предмет всего за уголь x10!

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ I owe them 32M coins.
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Я должен им 32M монет.

records.speaker: Bulvar
records.source: [NPC] Bulvar: ✆ Hmm? My Abiphone Contact?
records.translation: [NPC] Bulvar: ✆ Хм? Мой контакт в Абифоне?

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: I give ya a fancy lil' dart stick, you shoot sum Zombies!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Дам тебе славный дротикомёт — стреляй по зомби!

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Sorry pal, but ya need 5x Carnival Tickets to play!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Извини, приятель, для игры нужно 5 карнавальных билетов!

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Ye'll get more score based on what armor the Zombie's wearin'.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Чем лучше броня на зомби, тем больше очков.

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Mayor Foxy graciously allowed me to use this pond for my attraction.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Мэр Фокси любезно разрешила устроить мой аттракцион на этом пруду.

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: You will be given 100s to catch some fish with a fishing rod I will provide you.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Дам тебе удочку и 100 с на ловлю рыбы.

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Each type of fish has a different color and point value.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Каждый вид рыбы отличается цветом и количеством очков.

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Alas, not everyone can appreciate the art of fishing...
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Увы, не каждому дано оценить искусство рыбалки...

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Here, you'll be able to partake in fun activities, earn Carnival Tokens, and purchase cool prizes!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Здесь можно развлекаться, зарабатывать карнавальные жетоны и покупать отличные призы!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Each day, I'll give you 25x Carnival Tickets, which will let you play the games.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Каждый день дам тебе 25 карнавальных билетов для участия в играх.

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: It's a new day, which means you get more Carnival Tickets!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Новый день — новые карнавальные билеты!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Aim for a high score by killing the pesky Zombies walking around the arena!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Убивай зомби на арене и набирай побольше очков!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Lastly, there's Catch a Fish, located by the mountain pond.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: А у горного пруда — «Поймайте рыбу».

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Each day, I'll give you 25x Carnival Tickets.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Каждый день дам тебе 25 карнавальных билетов.

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: You'll be awarded 1 Token for every 100 points you earn.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Получишь 1 жетон за каждые заработанные 100 очков.

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Why, at the orange stand right over there!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: В оранжевой палатке, вон там!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: You can exchange your Tokens for permanent buffs in different Events throughout SkyBlock, as well as some fun masks to play around with.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Меняй жетоны на постоянные бонусы для событий SkyBlock и забавные маски.

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: The rules of the game are as follows - I give ye a shovel, ye dig up the sand on the lookout fer fruit!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Правила такие: дам тебе лопату — копай песок, ищи фрукты!

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: There's a bunch o' different fruits, each with differin' point values and abilities.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: У каждого фрукта свои очки и способности.

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Ye can RIGHT CLICK with yer shovel to swap between dowsing modes, which give ye a little info every time ye dig!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Нажимай ПКМ с лопатой, чтобы менять режимы поиска. При каждом раскопе получишь подсказку!

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Yer supposed to use that info to avoid them bombs and pick the best blocks to mine.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: По подсказкам обходи бомбы и выбирай, где лучше копать.

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: It might all sound a little confusin', but I bet ye'll get the hang of it if ye give it a try.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Звучит мудрёно, но попробуешь — быстро разберёшься!

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Here's yer shovel, then.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Тогда держи лопату.

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Sorry lad, but ye don't have 5x Carnival Tickets. Ye gotta pay to play!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Прости, малый, у тебя нет 5 карнавальных билетов. За игру надо платить!

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: The rules are as follows - I give ye a shovel, ye dig up the sand on the lookout fer fruit!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Правила такие: дам тебе лопату — копай песок, ищи фрукты!

records.speaker: Carpenter
records.source: [NPC] Carpenter: Could you bring a stack of White Wool to help replenish my stock?
records.translation: [NPC] Carpenter: Принесёшь стопку белой шерсти, чтобы пополнить мои запасы?

records.speaker: Chantelle
records.source: [NPC] Chantelle: ...but it's just so we can track your stats and let you complete challenges for rewards!
records.translation: [NPC] Chantelle: ...но лишь для учёта статистики и испытаний с наградами!

records.speaker: Clerk Seraphine
records.source: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Well, most of the Mayors have a total of 4 perks to choose from, the amount they have at once varying.
records.translation: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: У большинства мэров есть 4 возможных бонуса, но число действующих одновременно меняется.

records.speaker: Clerk Seraphine
records.source: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: They'll usually have somewhere from 1-3, with an 8% chance to receive a 4th if they already have 3.
records.translation: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Обычно их от 1 до 3. С вероятностью 8% добавляется 4-й, если уже есть 3.

records.speaker: Clerk Seraphine
records.source: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Candidates that were either elected as Mayor or Minister the previous Election sit out the following Election and only have a single perk when they return.
records.translation: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Кандидаты, ставшие мэром или министром на прошлых выборах, пропускают следующие. Вернувшись, они получают только один бонус.

records.speaker: Clerk Seraphine
records.source: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Each Mayor also has a ✯ Minister Perk, which goes hand-in-hand with the Minister system!
records.translation: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: У каждого мэра есть и ✯ бонус министра — часть системы министров!

records.speaker: Clerk Seraphine
records.source: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Each Mayor has a perk marked as a "✯ Minister Perk".
records.translation: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: У каждого мэра один из бонусов помечен как «✯ бонус министра».

records.speaker: Clerk Seraphine
records.source: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Once a Mayor is elected, the runner-up with the most votes is selected to act as their Minister.
records.translation: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: После избрания мэра кандидат, занявший второе место по голосам, становится его министром.

records.speaker: Clerk Seraphine
records.source: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Every few months, a Special Mayor enters the running.
records.translation: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Раз в несколько месяцев в выборах участвует особый мэр.

records.speaker: Clerk Seraphine
records.source: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Their perks are much stronger and crazier!
records.translation: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Его бонусы намного сильнее и необычнее!

records.speaker: Clerk Seraphine
records.source: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: The mayor elections are currently closed but come back later and check them out!
records.translation: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Сейчас выборы мэра закрыты, но загляни позже!

records.speaker: Clerk Seraphine
records.source: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: You can also vote in the mayor elections by heading through the warp to the left!
records.translation: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: Через портал слева можно пройти и проголосовать на выборах мэра!

records.speaker: Clerk Seraphine
records.source: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: ✆ Hm, you'd like my Abiphone Contact?
records.translation: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: ✆ Хм, хочешь мой номер абифона?

records.speaker: Clerk Seraphine
records.source: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: ✆ Give me a call if you ever want to vote remotely in a Mayor Election!
records.translation: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: ✆ Позвони мне, если захочешь проголосовать на выборах мэра издалека!

records.speaker: Clerk Seraphine
records.source: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: ✆ I just wanted to call to let you know that voting for this year's Mayor Election has begun!
records.translation: [NPC] Clerk Seraphine: ✆ Звоню сообщить: голосование на выборах мэра в этом году уже началось!

records.speaker: Doug
records.source: [NPC] Doug: Masks. Event buffs. An Accessory.
records.translation: [NPC] Doug: Маски. Бонусы событий. Аксессуар.

records.speaker: Dusk
records.source: [NPC] Dusk: Runes are cosmetic effects that drop from Runic mobs!
records.translation: [NPC] Dusk: Руны добавляют декоративные эффекты и выпадают из рунических существ!

records.speaker: Dusk
records.source: [NPC] Dusk: You can apply runes to weapons and armor with the Rune Pedestal behind me.
records.translation: [NPC] Dusk: На руническом пьедестале позади меня можно наносить руны на оружие и броню.

records.speaker: Dusk
records.source: [NPC] Dusk: If you're having trouble storing all the runes you've been collecting, you can buy a Rune Sack from Elizabeth in the Community Center!
records.translation: [NPC] Dusk: Если руны уже некуда складывать, купи мешок рун у Элизабет в Общественном центре!
